title: Add 15-year-old Ethan on a learner's permit; noisy living room; price unchanged

customer.name: Rachel Nguyen
customer.persona: Mom of three, calling from a busy living room. Your son Ethan (15) just got his learner's permit and you want to be sure he's covered while practicing.

license_status.say_it: just the learner's permit, he got it Tuesday

vehicle_assignment.say_it: the Outback, with me in the passenger seat

effective_date.say_it: today, he wants to practice this weekend

premium_change_monthly_usd.say_it: no change while he's on the permit

advice.rep_says: With Prairie Crest, permit drivers are listed at no charge until they're fully licensed; call us the day he passes and we'll re-rate.
advice.customer_decision: List Ethan as a permit driver now

advice.rep_says: When he takes driver's ed, keep the certificate: it earns a discount once he's licensed.
advice.customer_decision: Will do driver's ed in the spring

talk_track.beat: Greet: name, agency, 'this call is recorded', how can I help.
Your son got his learner's permit; you want him covered for practice. (Shush the kids once.)
Give your name and policy number.
Ask his full name and date of birth.
Ethan Nguyen (spell the last name), January 26th 2011, he's 15.
Read back (ask her to repeat one thing because of the noise). Ask the permit state.
Explain permit drivers are listed at no charge until licensed; ask which car he practices in and where it's kept.
The Outback, weekends with you; at home.
Mention the driver's-ed discount for later. Ask when to add him.
Today; he wants to practice this weekend.
Read back: Ethan, permit driver, occasional on the Outback, from today; premium stays $134, no change.
Say one moment; end the call.

handoff.line: OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll be one tap away if you need me.

conditions.background_noise: Customer side: TV on at medium volume and kids talking or playing near the phone for the whole call.

rep: Ask her to repeat something once because of the noise; that's realistic.
customer: Turn a TV or a video on at medium volume near you, or have someone chat nearby. Don't shout; talk normally.

traps: Premium does not change ($134, +$0): the AI must not invent an increase.
Background TV and kids on the customer channel: facts must still be extracted, and TV speech must not create phantom facts.
Learner's permit: the AI must not describe Ethan as licensed.
